text:
Leo: Heads up — we've had a few compliance asks: customers want a downloadable 'who changed routing policies' export that teams can drop into their SIEMs. Proposal: NDJSON export of change events with actor pseudonym, justification, minimal PII, and optional redaction/sampling. Thoughts?
Maya: Use cases? is this for audits, or live alerting? need retention/consent rules.
Sam: Primary use is audits + automated compliance scans. Also some sec teams want near-real-time streaming to SIEM (kafka/http).
Olivia: Performance concern — exporting full diffs for every change spikes storage. We should have "compact" vs "full" modes. Compact = metadata + link to bundle; Full = NDJSON blob with diff.
Josh: +1 to compact. Also we should include "actor_session" (short-lived token) + actor_resolution_hint so customers can map to SSO IDs in their side.
Maria: Privacy: default should hash actor_id and allow tenant-admin to opt into raw_actor for exports. Also strip IPs and token ids. We need explicit justification field.
Sam: API shape draft:

```
{ "ts": "2025-11-12T20:05:01Z", "actor_id_hash": "sha256:...", "actor_hint": "j.smith@acme.com",
  "action": "update_route", "resource": "tenant/42/routing/policy/17",
  "justification": "oncall fix for latency spike", "mode": "compact", "bundle_url": "https://console.redwood/..."
}
```

Maya: For streaming, we should push to customer's SIEM connector with HMAC signing and per-tenant endpoints.
Olivia: Also expose per-route telemetry (who rolled, rollout-id, %age, start/end) in console timeline. That solves many UX questions.
Leo: What about export quotas? some customers will try to stream everything. We should throttle per-tenant exports and offer reserved export throughput (like Dedicated).
Sam: Agree. Add "export_throttle" metric to billing+console. Default 1 req/s per tenant for streaming; allow overrides.
Josh: How do we handle rollbacks and false positives in exports? Need "change_id" + "supersedes" field so consumers can correlate.
Maria: Add redaction levels: none/pseudonymize/anonymize. Store decision in export artifact metadata so replay consumers can handle.
infra-bot: deploy scheduled: audit-export-v1 -> canary at 6pm PST
Maya: Action items: 1) Sam to draft API docs + NDJSON schema 2) Olivia to prototype compact vs full storage layout 3) Josh to add change_id & session hint to telemetry 4) Maria to write privacy defaults & redaction knobs
Sam: I'll put a PR up with schema sample and retention options by EOD tomorrow.
Leo: Thanks — if we can get a short spec by Friday we can sync with legal for the compliance pack. :thumbsup:
